notes.title: Update 1.3 Changelog
notes.content:
Fixed
- Increased Physic checks to prevent problems such as unable to grab ledges, when user is getting low fps
- Ledge grabbing on ledges vertically on top of each other causing glitches
- Sentry sprites Drawing on wrong layer
- Sentry Flying into walls endlessly and slowly passing through them
- Music tracks causing slight delay when loading next track
- Rail in 3-19 stretching bug
- Able to go down ladder while milli is active, if atto is on top of ladder

+ Pressing the Milli Key Twice to activate

+ Glow Effect changed to Bloom
+ Light Quality Defaulted to Max
+ Sound Levels Adjusted
+ Normal Maps added to more Objects
+ Fixed Navigation in Level Select Screen for Controllers

notes.title: Update 0.9.5
notes.content:
Added: Tutorial Messages in First Level
Added: Crushes wont kill you when retracting
Added: Level is now Displayed in Loading Screen and Pause Menu
Added: Large Gear in Level 1-5 now has sound
Added: When a New Portal Platform is activated, the Previous Platform (If any) is Disabled
Added: Atto Now has Crushed Animation
Added: Portal GUI
Added: Animation on treadmill added for clones
Added: Bottom Elevators in Level 2-16, now lock after use to prevent accidental activations

Fixed: Death was being ignored in some cases
Fixed: Able to Pause and un-pause time properly as Milli
Fixed: Exclusive Fullscreen mode removed (Causes freezing in DX11, might be re-added in the future)
Fixed: Portal Platforms now have proper limited use
Fixed: Light Quality is now Defaulted at High
Fixed: Horizontal Platform Colliders Fixed (Oversized)
Fixed: New Power for Milli now shows correct Keys/Buttons
Fixed: Default Controls Updated
Fixed: Buttons in Gui are no longer Automatically Selected when loaded

Warning Your Save File May be revert
